motivation: The 123-run Haggag reconstruction shows a known 1.35 condition cost settling to integer -1/-2 with frequencies compatible with an unbiased stochastic quantizer, while simple conserved carry is falsified. Stat gain timing also falsifies a constant carry model. Test whether Resource Coach residuals arise partly in a downstream discrete renderer rather than by altering the continuous response law.
invariants: Do not refit age bands, tier offsets, N/p dose, young-grey term, thresholds, K, rho or coach anchors in the primary settlement comparison.
Do not edit src/logic/resourceCoachV2.ts, production profiles, or frozen prior predictions.
HIST/quarantined records remain excluded exactly as in STRUCTURE_AUDIT_20260924.md.
A prediction generated after observing its target preview is never prospective evidence.

rendererHypotheses.R0: Continuous endpoints scored directly, current research baseline.
rendererHypotheses.RSUPPORT: conservative support [floor(mu_lo), ceil(mu_hi)]; no fitted parameters.
rendererHypotheses.RSTOCH1: Unbiased one-step stochastic quantizer: Y=floor(mu)+Bernoulli(frac(mu)); evaluate endpoint likelihood, not a deterministic replacement.
rendererHypotheses.RCOUNT: Only if RSTOCH1 is inadequate: count/quantile renderer with one dispersion parameter fitted on CAL only; parameter and quantile levels must be frozen before holdout scoring.

primaryQuestions: Do deterministic renderers materially improve player-disjoint MAE/inside rate versus R0 without changing upstream physics?
Are observed integer endpoints statistically calibrated under RSTOCH1, or do many lie outside {floor(mu),ceil(mu)}?
If RSTOCH1 fails, can a one-parameter discrete count renderer explain residual width and integer endpoints out of sample?
Does any renderer reduce the current Mstar prospective/player-disjoint residuals without erasing known coordinate-dependent structure?

partitions.calibration: Use the same admissible CAL pool frozen by the shape-model research, excluding HIST and all prospective targets used for final scoring.
partitions.validation: Leave-one-player-out and leave-one-coach-out, preserving preview clusters.
partitions.prospective: All predictions already frozen before observation plus future eligible PREREG-20260924-SHAPE-FIVE-MODEL arms. Never fit renderer parameters on these.

metrics: endpoint negative log likelihood for stochastic renderers
calibration of ceil/floor frequencies versus fractional part
promotionRule: No production change from this branch. A renderer becomes a production candidate only if it improves held-out/prespective error materially and calibration diagnostics pass without changing frozen upstream parameters. A retrospective-only improvement is recorded but not promoted.
falsifiers: If Resource Coach endpoints frequently lie farther than one integer from frozen continuous endpoints, RSTOCH1 is falsified as the sole renderer.
If deterministic rounding improves in-sample but not player-disjoint/prospective scores, rounding is not the missing mechanism.
If residuals retain strong coordinate/age/coach structure after settlement, upstream response/dose structure remains missing.
